name: smooth-scroll
title: Smooth Scroll
description: Smooth, interpolated scrolling for the page or a scroll container, built on Lenis: native scroll underneath, with a hook for the instance and scroll events.
author: darkroom.engineering <https://github.com/darkroomengineering>
docs:
Installed `SmoothScroll` in `components/ui/smooth-scroll.tsx` (with the upstream `ReactLenis`, `useLenis` and `LenisContext`), and the `lenis` package. For the whole page, render `<SmoothScroll root />` once near the top of your app; for a scroll container, wrap its content: `<SmoothScroll className="h-96 overflow-y-auto">...</SmoothScroll>`.

Read the instance with `useSmoothScroll()` (for example `lenis.scrollTo("#pricing")`), or pass a callback to run on every scroll. Lenis's stylesheet is included; under reduced motion wheel input tracks one to one.
